title: Strange Omnipod DASH error code
symptom: While injecting a bolus with Omnipod DASH, a POD Fault: 49 error occurred. The pod beeped until deactivated. The user requested a bolus, the app seemed stuck, and after killing the app and requesting another bolus, the pod fault appeared.
cause: The app crashed while a bolus was being delivered, and the user requested another bolus while the previous one was still being delivered, which may have caused the pod fault.
fix: The issue was fixed with a pull request (https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/1211). The maintainer suggested adding a check to prevent multiple boluses, but the exact fix is not detailed in the thread.
